name: Secant Method for Surface Depth Refinement
aliases: Linear Interpolation Root Finding for SDF
definition: An iterative root-finding algorithm used to refine the depth value $d$ where a signed distance function (or occupancy logit) crosses a threshold. It uses linear interpolation between two bracketing points $(d_{low}, f_{low})$ and $(d_{high}, f_{high})$ to estimate the next point.
summary: The Secant Method for Surface Depth Refinement is a derivative-free iterative algorithm that refines surface depth by linearly interpolating between bracketing points to find signed distance function zero-crossings.
